name: Fulbright Degree Program
sponsor: United States Educational Foundation in Pakistan (USEFP)
eligible_institutions: Universities all over the United States
fields_of_study: All academic disciplines are eligible, except clinical medicine. People seeking degrees in the Sciences, Technology and AI, Trade and Economics, or Natural Resource Management are particularly encouraged to apply.
domicile_requirements: Pakistani citizens with strong academic histories, residing (throughout the process) in Pakistan
merit_criteria: The Graduate Record Examination (GRE General) is required for all applicants. Under the new scoring system, a minimum score of 145 is required on each section of the GRE examination, with a higher score on the section most applicable to your field of study. High level of fluency in spoken and written English; selected candidates required to take TOEFL.
other_conditions: For Master's: 16 years of formal education; MBA and Public Policy/Administration require 2 years work experience. For PhD: minimum 18 years of formal education; work experience in teaching, research, or public sector highly desirable. Must sign contract/bond to return and serve Pakistan. Ineligible: dual U.S./Pakistani citizens or those with U.S. citizen/permanent resident spouse or child over 18; employees/contractors of Fulbright, US State Dept, USAID and relatives; past Fulbright awardees; persons already studying in the U.S. or holding work/residence/student visas abroad.
benefits: Tuition, required textbooks, airfare, a living stipend, and health insurance. GRE reimbursement available for up to 30 applicants attending/teaching at HEC approved public universities who score 300+ (engineering/science) or 290+ (humanities/social sciences).
application_procedure: Online application with references and required supporting documents must be submitted online. Paper applications will not be accepted.
required_documents: Application form, three reference letters, GRE score report, scanned transcripts including an explanation of the grading scale of the university issuing the degree.
attestation_requirements: HEC-attested documents are preferable with the application but degree and transcripts attested by the issuing authority will be acceptable at the time of application. High school and post-secondary diplomas or certificates do not need to be officially verified/attested.
contact_address: Islamabad: Building No. 99, Sector H-8/1, Islamabad; Lahore: USEFP Inside FC College, Gulberg, Lahore; Karachi: Office no. 03-04, 5th Floor, 19 C, Khayaban-e-Nishat, Phase 6 DHA, Karachi
evidence_quote: The scholarship funds graduate study at universities all over the United States for a Master's or PhD degree, including tuition, required textbooks, airfare, a living stipend, and health insurance.

name: Commonwealth Master's Scholarships
sponsor: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office (FCDO) / Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK (CSC)
eligible_institutions: Any approved UK university or higher education institution with which the CSC has a part-funding agreement
fields_of_study: Offered under the six CSC development themes
domicile_requirements: Be a citizen of or have been granted refugee status by an eligible Commonwealth country, or be a British Protected Person. Be permanently resident in an eligible Commonwealth country.
merit_criteria: Candidate merit (including academic experience), quality of research proposal, and potential impact on the development of the candidate's home country.
need_criteria: Be unable to afford to study in the UK without this scholarship.
min_gpa_or_marks: By September 2027, hold a first degree of at least upper second-class (2:1) honours standard, or a lower second-class degree and a relevant postgraduate qualification (usually a Master's degree).
age_limit: There is no age limit for CSC applications.
other_conditions: The CSC funds one-year taught Master's programmes only and does not fund MBA degrees. Applicants must not have already studied at Master's level at a UK institution, or have already received a Commonwealth Scholarship at Master's level.
benefits: Approved airfare from the Scholar's home country to the UK and return, full tuition fees covered, stipend at the rate of £1,712 per month or £2,000 per month for those at universities in the London metropolitan area, study travel grant, child allowance of £622 per month for the first child and £154 per month for the second and third child under the age of 16 if eligible.
application_procedure: Applications to the CSC are made using the application system, CSC Central, alongside applying to a nominator such as a National nominating agency or selected non-governmental organisations and charitable bodies.
required_documents: Proof of citizenship or refugee status (valid passport or national ID card), full transcripts detailing all higher education qualifications with certified translations, references from at least two individuals in PDF format.
attestation_requirements: References must be on institution letterhead or an email clearly showing the sender's details and signed.
evidence_quote: The closing date for applications is 16:00 BST on Tuesday 20 October.
